lines.t:
A type of <c:ffff00>stat<c> for <c:ffff00>head<c> and <c:ffff00>arm<c> <c:ffff00>{{part|pl}}<c>.

Measures the speed of physical follow-up
movements after an <c:ffff00>act<c>, such as low {{recoil}} and little
exposure, including cooldown efficiency.

The higher the value, the less time the <c:ffff00>{{cooldown}}<c> of
an <c:ffff00>action<c> takes.
